subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Ordinal numbers: first, second, third up to sixth, and last

show.line: The dinosaurs are in a line. The big one is first. The small one is last.

rounds.prompt: Which dinosaur is first in the line?
Which dinosaur is last in the line?
The tortoises race. Who came second?
The crocodile is third in the race. Where is the crocodile? Say first, second or third.
Which lizard is fourth? Count first, second, third, fourth.

hints: Start counting at the front. First, second, third.
The one at the very end is last.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will point to the first dinosaur.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This one at the back is first!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The one at the back is last.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: First is at the front. The one at the back is last!

parent_line: Can say first, second, third and last.
